subject.title: fix(tasks): reset omitted lifecycle start time

question: Should bundled plugins that emit a reserved lifecycle start without a finite producer timestamp now receive an explicit rejection?
rationale: Supported OpenClaw producer paths inspected provide timestamps and strict admission prevents fabricated durable timing, but this intentionally changes an exposed bundled-plugin API response for malformed payloads.

options.title: Confirm strict rejection
options.body: Make finite startedAt mandatory for reserved lifecycle starts, repair the remaining fixture, and merge after exact-head checks pass.

options.title: Preserve response compatibility
options.body: Keep the durable task correction but narrow plugin-side enforcement if malformed bundled-plugin emissions must retain apparent success.

recommendation.title: Confirm strict rejection
recommendation.body: Make finite startedAt mandatory for reserved lifecycle starts, repair the remaining fixture, and merge after exact-head checks pass.

likelyOwner.reason: The immediately preceding merged feature history ties this owner to the shared event, plugin API, and task projection contracts being changed.
